modelDescription:
Dark Storm DS-15 Typhoon Pistol

  • DS-15 7075 Billet Aluminum Receiver Set with Fixed Mag Lower Receiver
  • Type III Mil Spec Hard Coat Anodize Black
  • NOTE: Due to the nature of the anodizing process, color tints may vary. 
  • DSI Chinook Ambidextrous Charging Handle
  • DSI Billet Ambidextrous 90 Degree Safety Selector
  • DSI M16 Bolt Carrier Group
  • DSI Typhoon M-Lok 6" Hand Guard
  • DSI Steel Micro Gas Block
  • Pistol Gas System
  • DSI 7.5" .300 Blackout Threaded 1:8 Nitrite Barrel
  • DSI Firestorm Compensator
  • Magpul PMAG 10
  • Hogue Pistol Grip Black
  • Optic Ready (sights not included)
  • Trigger Lock
  • Effective 11/10/23 ships with SB Tactical SBA3 Brace
